description: This file defines the ModifySubject class, which represents a command used to modify a Subject within a Policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating, parsing from JSON, accessing properties, and serializing the command.

classes.name: ModifySubject
classes.description: An immutable command class for modifying a Subject within a Policy's entry, providing serialization, deserialization, and property access methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ModifySubject with specific parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifySubject instance.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the PolicyEntry related to this command.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the Subject to be modified.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the Subject, if applicable.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes command data into a JSON object builder.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, here 'MODIFY'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
